summary: Frontend-only Expo/React Native web preview testing for MIUI-inspired multi-purpose CalcHub calculator app. Ran comprehensive UI validation across all major screens (home, standard/scientific calculator, GST, SIP, EMI, currency, converters, temperature, discount, BMI, numeral, age, date, search, settings). All calculations numerically correct: 7x8+9=65, (2+3)*4=20, 5/0=Cannot divide by zero, sin(30) DEG=0.5, 5!=120, 2^10=1024, log(100)=2, pi=3.14159265, GST 1000@18%=1180/GST180, discount 2000@20%=1600/save400, temp 100C=212F, BMI 70kg/175cm=~22.86, numeral dec 10=1010/12/A. Favorites persist across reload. Theme switching works. Search returns matching tools. No React Native red screen errors. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) used. Only cosmetic console warnings (pointerEvents deprecated prop, shadow* props, useNativeDriver web fallback) — non-blocking.

issues: Home 'search bar' is a Pressable (navigates to /search) rather than an inline TextInput; visually looks like an input but has no data-testid=search-input on the home screen. This is acceptable UX but the review request implied an input on home. The actual /search screen has the working search input.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native web console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely emitted by a library/react-native-web version; low priority.
'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Emitted on web only; low priority.

action_items: (Optional) Add a data-testid=search-input to the home dashboard search Pressable or convert it to an actual TextInput per the review request wording.
(Optional) Migrate any lingering shadow* / pointerEvents usages to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents for react-native-web to silence deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Safe expression parser (src/utils/calc/expression.ts) properly avoids eval/Function, uses tokenizer + recursive-descent parser with correct precedence, right-associative ^, factorial with overflow guard, DEG/RAD handling, divide-by-zero and NaN checks.
AsyncStorage-backed persistence works for theme, favorites, and calc mode/angle. Verified via reload (Favorites section persists).
All tools have testIDs on interactive elements. Modal-based selectors documented in the review request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully offline (no backend). Base URL: https://app-runner-132.preview.emergentagent.com. Mobile viewport 390x844. Key testIDs: tab-*, mode-standard/scientific, btn-* (calculator), gst-amount/gst-rate/gst-mode-add/gst-mode-remove, sip-amount/sip-rate/sip-duration/sip-type, emi-amount/emi-rate/emi-duration, currency-amount, unit-value, temp-value, discount-price/discount-percent/discount-tax, bmi-weight/bmi-height, numeral-input, age-dob-day/month/year, favorite-toggle-<toolId>, theme-light/dark/system. History items use testID history-item-<id> (empty when no prior calcs in same browser session).
